title: The Production Defect
brief: {{cust}}, a customer of the Meridian Digital booking platform, reports that confirmation emails since Tuesday show the wrong appointment time for 1 in 20 bookings. They ask for a written response within 24 hours. You have 12 visit points to contain the defect, find the cause, and prepare the response.

actions.label: General condition of the area
actions.note: Nothing of note for the purpose of this visit.

actions.label: A staff member: anything else to mention
actions.note: The staff member has nothing further to add on this topic.

actions.label: What changed in the email template
Older records for this area
actions.note: The older records show nothing relevant to this visit.

actions.label: Notices and signs in the area
actions.note: The notices are current and not relevant to this visit.

evidence.text: Incident INC-902 was logged within 30 minutes with the customer's examples and a priority.
4 other customers raised similar tickets since Tuesday; they were closed as "user error" and not linked to INC-902.
evidence.whyItMatters: When nonconforming output is identified, all affected output and customers must be identified and controlled.
evidence.missedExplanation: Search for similar tickets beyond the complainant.

evidence.text: Release register: release 12.6 was deployed on Tuesday with change list and build number 5520.
evidence.whyItMatters: Traceability to the release is in place.

evidence.text: Release 12.6 sign-off records 2 failing time-zone tests marked "known issue, low risk" by the developer who wrote the change.
evidence.whyItMatters: Release with failing verification needs an authorized decision independent of the author.

evidence.text: Error logs for release 12.6 show 0 errors; the defect produces wrong content, not failures. Monitoring checks only sending success.
evidence.whyItMatters: Monitoring the content of outputs would detect this type of defect. An improvement opportunity.
evidence.missedExplanation: Ask what the monitoring can and cannot detect.

evidence.text: Developer: "We changed the template to use the server time instead of the customer's time zone. It was a small change." Change CHG-1201 has no impact review.
evidence.whyItMatters: Changes must be reviewed for effect before release.
evidence.missedExplanation: Ask what changed and whether its effect was reviewed.

evidence.text: Time-zone tests cover 2 of the customer's 6 time zones listed in requirement TZ-4.
evidence.whyItMatters: Verification should cover the stated requirements.
evidence.missedExplanation: Compare test coverage with requirement lists.

evidence.text: Complaint response procedure requires a first written response with containment within 24 hours.
Customer service levels define severity 2 for wrong customer-facing data, with a 24-hour response.
evidence.whyItMatters: Requirements for response are defined and reviewed.

evidence.text: Data query identifies 1,240 affected confirmations across 5 customers since Tuesday.
evidence.whyItMatters: The affected population can be identified.
The status page reports availability, which is correct; it does not claim data accuracy.
evidence.falseFindingNote: The service is up. The defect is in content, which the status page does not cover.

evidence.text: Database tables use short names such as "bk_tz".
evidence.whyItMatters: Naming style is not a requirement.
evidence.falseFindingNote: Naming style does not affect conformity.

decisions.prompt: What should the 24-hour response to {{cust}} include?
options: A statement that the system is operational

What happened in plain terms, the affected bookings identified, containment (rollback of the template change and corrected confirmations), the cause under investigation, actions with dates, and a contact
An offer of a discount only
A request that the customer checks every booking
decisions.rationale: The customer needs facts, containment, and a plan. A discount alone does not address the defect.

containment: Roll back the template change and send corrected confirmations to all 5 affected customers
Reopen the 4 tickets closed as user error and link them to INC-902
correction: Correct the 1,240 confirmations with customer agreement on wording
cause: Template changes have no impact review, time-zone tests are incomplete, and authors can accept their own failing tests
corrective: Require impact review and independent acceptance of known test failures; extend time-zone tests to all listed zones
effectiveness: Monitor confirmation accuracy by sampling and review ticket closure reasons for three months

debriefText.found: You contained beyond the complaint and traced the cause through change and release.
debriefText.missed: Check whether similar tickets were closed under another label.
debriefText.falseFinding: An accurate status page and naming style are not part of this defect.
